visualCharacteristics.purpose: downloadable images (wallpapers, calendars) with one link per size
visualCharacteristics.description: Left-aligned wrapping grid of ~345px cards: image on top, title, then format rows laid out as a 3-column grid (label | size link | size link).

contentPattern.structure: one row per downloadable; cell 1 = image; cell 2 = title paragraph, then one paragraph per format: the label text followed by its size links (e.g. Desktop 1920x1080 1024x768)
contentPattern.notes: A paragraph holding only links continues the previous format row. Size links get an accessible name "<title> <label> <size> Download" unless authored with one.

suitableFor: wallpaper / calendar / asset downloads offered in several sizes or formats
